### 1 — Scene
A mixed meal of sliced cooked chicken, leafy salad, cauliflower, and roasted vegetables.

### 2 — Vessel
A large, shallow square dinner plate, approximately **28 cm across**. Using the requested circular approximation:  
**Area = 3.14 × 14² ≈ 615 cm².**

### 3 — Items
Visible foods appear to be chicken breast, mixed salad leaves, cauliflower, roasted potatoes, and orange roasted vegetables, likely sweet potato. A light oily sheen suggests a little dressing or cooking oil; no thick sauce is visible.

### 4–7 — Area, volume, weight, and energy
Areas represent each food’s share of the plate, without double-counting overlapping ingredients. Oil coats the food rather than occupying a separate area.

| Item | Plate area | Area × height = gross volume | Bulk density | Estimated weight | kcal/100 g | Energy |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Chicken breast | 20% | 123 cm² × 1.3 cm = 160 ml | 0.95 | 152 g | 165 | 251 kcal |
| Mixed leafy greens | 38% | 234 cm² × 2.4 cm = 562 ml | 0.15 | 84 g | 20 | 17 kcal |
| Cauliflower | 13% | 80 cm² × 2 cm = 160 ml | 0.55 | 88 g | 25 | 22 kcal |
| Roasted potatoes | 12% | 74 cm² × 1.8 cm = 133 ml | 0.65 | 86 g | 100 | 86 kcal |
| Roasted sweet potato | 6% | 37 cm² × 1.7 cm = 63 ml | 0.65 | 41 g | 90 | 37 kcal |
| Visible oil/dressing | Coating | Approximately 7 ml | 0.92 | 6 g | 884 | 53 kcal |

**Coverage check:** 20 + 38 + 13 + 12 + 6 = **89%**, consistent with a mostly covered plate. Oil is counted separately from the vegetables’ energy values.

### 8 — Sanity check
The estimate is **457 g and 466 kcal**. This is plausible for a large plate with substantial chicken and vegetables, while the bulky leafy portion weighs relatively little. Oil quantity and the identity of the roasted vegetables are the main uncertainties.
